title.zh: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote
title.en: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote

current_state.zh: The CFTC updated its guidance for registered crypto entities to allow customer funds to be invested in tokenized assets with equivalent legal rights and to permit blockchain-based recordkeeping, framed as providing regulatory clarity after a failed CLARITY Act vote.
